_comment: ORDER-1350. DATED swap-mode + swap-charge probe on the pinned lane. Written by lane S-2026-08-04-SWAPPROBE. This file exists because the premise in scripts/swap_adjust_crypto.py is a 2026-07-26 measurement of BROKER STATE, and broker state moves under it -- so a probe result is only meaningful with the date it was taken. Two probes, both diagnostic: (TST)_SymbolSwapProbe reads the spec and places no orders; (TST)_SwapChargeProbe holds one position and reports what the tester actually charged. No verdict is issued here and no cell is judged.

note: swap_long reads -14.67 pct/yr in the 2026-07-26 record of the same probe. CAUTION, added by /scrutinize before this file was believed: that earlier reading does NOT name the install it was taken on, and BTC data is known to differ across installs (memory btc-tick-data-differs-per-mt5-install), so -14.67 -> -14.31 is NOT established as a rate that moved over time -- it is equally consistent with two lanes. It is therefore NOT a second confirmation of ORDER-1330; the deal-list diff remains the only demonstrated one. Settling it costs one run of this same probe on the second install, which is not made here because it would put a BTCUSD run on a lane design 8.3 pins away from it.
inputs_caveat: mt5_run.ps1 printed its NOSETFILE warning: no -SetFile was passed, so every EA input came from this terminal's tester cache. For the spec probe that reads only symbol properties and changes nothing; it is recorded because the repo's own rule (ORDER-165, memory mt5-tester-cache-nondeterminism) is that a run without a full .set is not reproducible, and a probe that is quoted as evidence must carry that.

refutes: the 2026-07-26 conclusion recorded in scripts/swap_adjust_crypto.py's docstring, that a SYMBOL_SWAP_MODE_INTEREST_CURRENT symbol is NOT charged swap by the tester -- net == price-only P&L to the cent. On this dated run the tester charged -20.21 on a single 0.01-lot position held 70 days, so it is not zero and the two figures are not equal.
note: -20.21 is the same order of magnitude as, and somewhat below, a naive annual-rate calculation over the same hold (0.01 lot x contract 1 x ~103k mean notional x 14.31 pct / 360 x 70 = about 29). WHY THE GAP IS NOT EXPLAINED HERE: rollover-day counting and the price each daily charge is valued at are the obvious candidates, but neither was measured, so this record does not assert either -- /scrutinize removed a sentence that did. What IS established is the only thing this probe was run to establish: the charge is not zero, so the premise 'net == price-only P&L to the cent' is false on this build today. No adjusted profit factor is recomputed from this record -- that is ORDER-1370's job and it is applied to every arm at once.
inputs_caveat: no -SetFile was passed, so _01_Lot / _01_Sell / _06_Magic came from this terminal's tester input cache. The report confirms what actually ran (BUY 0.01), so the observation is interpretable, but a re-run is not guaranteed to use the same inputs -- ORDER-165, memory mt5-tester-cache-nondeterminism. Pin a full .set before this probe is used for anything beyond 'the charge is non-zero'.
